content.hebrew: מִ֒זְמוֹר לְיוֹם שַׁבָּת : עִם שִׁיר אֲזַמֵּר
content.english: A psalm for the Sabbath day I shall sing with song,

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
He is the First and the Last, the one who dwells on high,

content.hebrew: צִוָּה בְּתוֹרָה עַל : יַד אִישׁ אֱלֹהִים
content.english: Who commanded the Torah through the Man of God:
To hallow the Sabbath, blessed by Adonai,
After He finished creating form and matter.

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
The concern of men is to pursue their business,
To discuss their affairs, coming and going.
All diligent crafts are forbidden,

content.hebrew: זוּלַת חֲשׁוֹב מִצְוָה : בֵּין קַל וְחוֹמֶר:
content.transliteration: Zulat ḥashov mitsva : ben ḳal veḥomer.
content.english: Except to contemplate the commandments, between “heavy” and “light”!

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
Fruitful acts [on the Sabbath] involve studying,
The purity of clean hands, fine clothes,
Walking inside the limit to the synagogue,
Food and drink that replenish the body!

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
Those who know the foundation of the Scriptures, the skilled sages,
Have wisely studied the holy knowledge:

content.hebrew: כִּי יוֹם מְנוּחוֹת זֶה : עוֹנֶג נְפָשִׁים
content.english: That the day of rest is delight for the souls:
As you learn the words of God, rejoice and sing!

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
On the path of truth, they advised their congregants
To be wary of doing any labor at home,

content.hebrew: בַּל יַעֲרִימוּ צַוּ- : וֹת אֶת מְשָׁרְתָם
content.transliteration: Bal ya‘arimu tsav- : vot et mesharetam
content.english: So that they will not scheme to command their servants:
To suggest any desecration—all the more so with words!

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
He will supply His people with prosperity and abundant kindness,
He will look down from His holy and high abode,

content.hebrew: הָכִין לְצָרְכָם בִּדְ- : בַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ
content.transliteration: Hachin letsorcham bid- : var yom beyomo
content.english: Preparing for their needs each day:
Double portion for the Sabbath; God remembers and keeps.

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.
He will supply the students with learning and acumen:
Surely, the superb words of knowledge are from His mouth!
His deeds bear witness how to understand His magnitude

content.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְיָד עֹשֶׂה : אָכֵן בְּאֹמֶר:
content.english: For He creates not with His hand but with speech.

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.

content.hebrew: חִ֒זְ֒ק֒וּ וְ֒יַאְ֒מֵ֒ץ֒ הָ- : אֵל אֶת לְבַבְכֶם
content.transliteration: Ḥizḳu veyamets ha- : el et levavchem
content.english: Be strong and God will raise your spirits!
Those who wait for His mercy—here is your reward:
If you observe the Sabbath, your souls
Will be worthy of enjoying the splendor in the Afterlife.

content.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב : כִּי טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת צוּר : אוֹמֵר וְגוֹמֵר:
content.transliteration: Ki tov ki tov lehodot : tsur omer veḡomer.
content.english: For it is good / for it is good to praise the Rock who speaks decisively.

content.hebrew: כַּכָּתוּב: אָ֗ז תִּתְעַנַּג֙ עַל־יְהוָ֔ה וְהִרְכַּבְתִּ֖יךָ עַל־בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֑רֶץ
content.transliteration: Kakkatuv: Az tit‘annaḡ ‘al adonai vehirkavticha ‘al bamoté arets.
content.english: As it is written: Then you can seek the favor of Adonai. I will set you astride the heights of the earth… (Is. 58:14).
